/bin/zsh -c "terraform fmt -check -diff terraform && git diff --check && git status --short && printf '\\n--- acceptance evidence ---\\n' && rg -n 'aws_ssm_parameter|image_id|associate_public_ip_address|aws_eks_node_group|instance_types|scaling_config|taint|runner_min_size|runner_desired_size|runner_max_size' terraform && printf '\\n--- map references ---\\n' && rg -n 'inputs/transient|U1 and U2 remain|Status: open' .agent-wayfinder || true"
